_comment: Explicit parameter set applied at the start of EVERY run (prereg parameter-explicitness amendment). Values and enums confirmed against commander_params.c at both pinned commits (file identical in A and B). Defaults noted for reference.

COM_RC_IN_MODE.why: Joystick (MAVLink MANUAL_CONTROL) only. Source default 3; SITL rcS set-default 1.

COM_FAIL_ACT_T.why: Failsafe action delay (Hold before action), s (default 5).

NAV_DLL_ACT.why: Datalink-loss action disabled (default 0); telemetry stays alive anyway.

COM_DISARM_PRFLT.why: Auto-disarm if no takeoff within 10 s of arming (default).
